title: Before / after - It took me 12 versions to make my card game feel like I would.
author: Final_gamedev
selftext:
Hey! Building with Claude let me try a lot of ideas really fast, which turned out to be a blessing and a curse: **I kept making new versions without understanding what was actually missing.**

Last week I shared an early beta of my card game (it was called Tenuta). Since then I’ve reworked almost everything, name included: it’s now Folkwall.

After a lot of attempts (and throwing away whole modes) I think it finally clicked. Still far from done, but I’m really proud of it.

Happy to chat about the process, and any feedback on the game is super welcome. 

Link in the comments.

comments.author: Final_gamedev
comments.body:
Here it is: [https://finalstudiodev.itch.io/folkwall](https://finalstudiodev.itch.io/folkwall)   
Thanks for checking it out!

replies.author: Final_gamedev
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Out of curiosity, what did you like more about the old one? The cleaner look, or was it just easier to read? I’m still working on the art, so this really helps.
